Learned counsel for the appellant prays for and is allowed 1 week's time to file rejoinder affidavit.
As per the office-report dated 09.01.2023, notice has already been served on the opposite party no.2, but till date no counter affidavit has been filed by her.
As a last opportunity, 3 days' time is granted to her to file counter affidavit, if any.
List this case on 19.10.2023."
Today also, no counter has been filed on behalf of the opposite party No. 2 nor any counsel has put in appearance on her behalf.
It appears that the opposite party No. 2 is not interested to contest this case.
In view of the above, this court has no option, but to consider the appeal.
Heard Sri Arshad Ahsan Siddiqui, learned counsel for the appellant as well as the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.

This Criminal Appeal under Section 14-A (2) of Scheduled Castes & Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act has been preferred against the impugned order dated 27.07.2022 passed by learned Special Judge, S.C./S.T. Act, Raebareli, in Bail Application No. 1189 of 2022, Ram Milan Patel v.
State of U.P., F.I.R./Case Crime No. 192 of 2022, under Sections 376(2)(?), 342, I.P.C. and Section 3(2)(v) of the S.C./S.T. Act, Police Station Unchahar, District Raebareli, whereby the bail application of the appellant has been rejected.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case due to enmity and village rivalry.
No such case, alleged by the prosecution, has ever taken place.

The F.I.R was lodged by the mother of the prosecutrix on 11.4.2022 regarding incident dated 10.4.2022 under Sections 354(?), 342, I.P.C., Section 7/8,
POCSO Act, and 3(2)(?) of the S.C./S.T. (P.A.) Act.
In the F.I.R. the allegation of molestation was levelled against the appellant.
Thereafter, statement of the prosecutrix was recorded under Section 161, Cr.P.C. in which she has repeated almost the same version of the F.I.R.

Thereafter, her statement under Section 164, Cr.P.C. was recorded, in which she has almost taken a somersault on the pressure created by the Police and the family members and she has made an allegation of rape against the appellant.
However, she on the first instance refused for internal medical examination of the victim.

The first medical of the victim was done on 12.4.2022 at 11.36 a.m. at C.H.C. Unchahar,
Raebareli, and as the mother had refused for internal examination, only external examination was done and in that examination the doctor has not given any opinion regarding sexual assault nor there exists any internal or external injury
. Age of the victim was found to be about 18 years as per her radiological examination.

Thereafter, second medical examination was conducted on 6.5.2022,
in which also no any external and internal injuries was seen at the time of examination.
There was no sign of use of force, however, final opinion was reserved pending to the availability of FSL reports.
Till date, it was confirmed by the learned counsel, that no FSL report is available on record.

This fact has also been submitted by the learned A.G.A., thus, the counsel submitted that in absence of any positive medical report which could ascertain the commission of rape, against the appellant, the Ram Milan Patel vs State Of U.P. sentences.text: entire prosecution story appears to be false and fabricated, lodged only with the intention to defame the image of the appellant and his entire family in the society.
Several other submissions in order to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against the appellant have also been placed forth before the Court.
The circumstances which, according to the counsel, led to the false implication of the accused have also been touched upon at length.

It has been assured on behalf of the appellant that he is ready to cooperate with the process of law and shall faithfully make himself available before the court whenever required and is also ready to accept all the conditions which the Court may deem fit to impose upon him.

It has also been pointed out that the accused is not having any criminal history, which fact has been stated in para-29 of the affidavit filed in support of the bail-application and he is in jail since 06.05.2022 and he has already undergone substantial period of detention and that in the wake of heavy pendency of cases in the Court, there is no likelihood of any early conclusion of trial.
Learned A.G.A. for the State opposed the prayer for bail and argument advanced by the learned counsel for the appellant.

He submits that as the offence is prima facie made out against the appellant, thus, the bail-application as well as the appeal be rejected, however, he is unable to dispute the contentions raised by learned counsel for the appellant.

After perusing the record in the light of the submissions made at the bar and after taking an overall view of all the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of evidence, the period of detention already undergone, the unlikelihood of early conclusion of trial and also in the absence of any convincing material to indicate the possibility of tampering with the evidence, this Court finds force in the submissions of the learned counsel for the appellant that in her statement recorded under Section 161, Cr.P.C. the prosecutrix has repeated almost the same version of the F.I.R., however, in her statement under Section 164, Cr.P.C. she has almost taken a somersault on the pressure created by the Police and the family members and she has made allegation of rape against the appellant, but she, at the first instance, refused for internal medical examination of the victim.

In the first medical of the victim done on 12.4.2022 at 11.36 a.m. at C.H.C. Unchahar, Raebareli, but as the mother/informant had refused for internal examination of the victim, only external examination was done and in that examination the doctor has not given any opinion regarding sexual assault nor there exists any internal or external injury.
Age of the victim was found to be about 18 years as per her radiological examination.

Thereafter, second medical examination was conducted on 6.5.2022,
in which also no any external and internal injuries was seen at the time of examination.
There was no sign of use of force, however, final opinion was reserved pending to the availability of FSL reports.
Till date, it was submitted by the learned counsel, that no FSL report is available on record.

This fact has also been confirmed by the learned A.G.A., thus, the counsel submitted that in absence of any positive medical report which could ascertain the commission of rape, against the appellant,
the entire prosecution story appears to be false and fabricated, lodged only with the intention to defame the image of the appellant and his entire family in the society and considering the fact that there are contradictions in the statements of the prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C; allegation of rape got demolished after perusal of medical report of the prosecutrix, wherein doctor has clearly stated that no definite opinion regarding sexual assault can be given; the age of the prosecutrix is 18 years, and further considering the larger mandate of the Article 21 of the Ram Milan Patel vs State Of U.P.
